evals.name: existing-project-requires-consent
evals.prompt: J'ai déjà une application Next.js. Termine l'écran et rends-le consultable localement.
evals.expected_output: Hand off the verified local build, explain annotation changes, and ask for confirmation before injecting them. Do not claim annotation is installed.

evals.name: explicit-install-is-consent
evals.prompt: Installe le mécanisme d'annotation dans mon projet Vite existant et vérifie-le.
evals.expected_output: Treat the explicit request as consent and claim success only after toggle, POST, inbox write, and production behavior are verified.

evals.name: static-astro-blocker
evals.prompt: Ajoute les annotations à ce site Astro configuré avec output: static.
evals.expected_output: Do not install a route that will fail. Explain that a server or hybrid adapter is required and ask whether the user approves that change.
